attack: Add a white-on-white valid date after the visible expired date.
attacker_goal: Hide the expired validity date from a text-first review.

attack: Use a full-width zero in a wrong document reference.
attacker_goal: Make a wrong reference harder to compare visually and by text rules.

attack: Add printed signature-looking text without a cryptographic signature.
attacker_goal: Make a blank signature field appear present to text extraction.

attack: Re-serialize a byte-identical duplicate so its SHA-256 changes.
attacker_goal: Avoid exact-file duplicate matching while preserving page content.

attack: Append a later PDF revision to a locally test-signed sample.
attacker_goal: Keep the signed appearance while changing the PDF after signing.
